survey_design.weight_fields_interpretation: This OECD country note does not use student-level ILSA microdata (e.g., PISA/TIMSS/PIRLS) and therefore does not define a sampling frame, plausible values, or survey-weighted estimation for student outcomes. The document describes governance responsibilities and expenditure/execution roles across national, regional (Fylkeskommuner), and local (Kommuner) levels for Norway’s adult skills system. Because no assessment administration, scaling, or student response data are analyzed, there are no weight variables (e.g., W_FSTUWT/TOTWGT) to apply. Any weighting guidance for ILSA microdata would not be applicable to this governance mapping note.

data.handling_not_reported_explanation: This document is a governance and institutional-responsibility country note, not an empirical analysis of student performance on an ILSA assessment. As such, there are no cognitive achievement outcomes with Plausible Values and no missing-data mechanism for PV-based scores to report. The absence of missing-data handling is therefore by design because no student-level dataset is analyzed.

sample_details.sample_filtering_criteria: No ILSA microdata sample is used. The note provides a descriptive overview of Norway’s adult skills governance structure and responsibilities across national, regional, and local levels.

data.outcome_summary: This OECD Norway country note describes how adult skills systems are governed and implemented across levels of government, rather than analyzing student achievement data from an ILSA assessment. It outlines the decentralised governance model in Norway: national ministries set legal and strategic frameworks, while regional (Fylkeskommuner) and local (Kommuner) authorities develop and deliver strategies and services. The note specifies responsibilities across policy areas including VET, HVET, CET, adult education (AE), and active labour market policies (ALMPs), and it maps key stakeholders (ministries, directorates/agencies, social partners, expert councils, and regional/local providers). It also reports a governance/expenditure structure indicator for subnational government (32.1% of general government expenditure at the sub-national level). No assessment design, scaling, benchmarks, or predictive performance metrics are applicable because no student-level testing or modeling is conducted.
data.null_fields_interpretation: This is not an empirical large-scale assessment study: it is a descriptive policy/governance country note. Consequently, fields required for ML or ILSA psychometric analyses (e.g., plausible values, missing-data handling, sample sizes, and predictive model performance) are not populated because there is no student-level dataset or outcome modeling. The extraction is therefore intentionally sparse and focuses on governance mapping rather than measurement or estimation.
